description: This Java source file defines the entity class 'LoanTransactionRelation' which models relationships between loan transactions and charges within the Fineract loan portfolio module. It includes JPA annotations for database mapping and utility methods for linking transactions and charges.

classes.name: LoanTransactionRelation
classes.description: Entity class representing the relationship between loan transactions and charges, including methods to create links between them.

methods.name: linkToTransaction
methods.description: Static method to create a relation linking a 'from' transaction to a 'to' transaction, and adds this relation to the 'from' transaction.

methods.name: linkToCharge
methods.description: Static method to create a relation linking a 'from' transaction to a loan charge.
